## 1. Executive Summary

TopFlowNG was rebuilt end to end and shipped to production in fully autonomous mode. The product now runs on a single world-class design system (Deep Teal) across the public landing, auth, customer app, and admin console, with complete light/dark themes and real provider logos. The customer catalogue was aligned with the live provider: 9mobile was rebranded to T2 (official logo + `#FF5C05` accent), and electricity coverage grew from 6 to all 12 verified DISCOs. A critical production defect — electricity/cable/recharge-pin purchases sending an empty phone to VTPass — was fixed at the route layer with a payload-audit test suite. Every gate is green: syntax 51/51, frontend/static 78/78, backend 216/216, browser 72/72, GitHub Actions green on all pushed commits, and production serves the new build with all assets returning 200. No customer-facing `9mobile` string remains; internal contract keys are intentionally preserved.

## 3. What Changed

### A. Design
- **Semantic token layer**: `--bg/--surface/--surface-raised/--surface-muted`, `--text-primary/-secondary/-muted`, `--border-subtle/-strong`, `--brand/-hover/-soft/-ink`, semantic `--success/--warning/--danger/--info`, and a focus-ring token — each independently designed for light and dark themes (dark bg `#0C1828`, surfaces `#132038`/`#182A45`; light `#F4F6F9`/`#FFFFFF`).
- **Fixed dark-theme selector bug**: CSS used `[data-theme="dark"]` while JS toggles the `.dark` class — dark mode had never applied. Now `html.dark` selectors.
- **Fixed dead CSS vars**: the additive shell styles referenced undefined vars (`--mist`, `--green-strong`, `--white`, `--red`, `--blue`, `--dur`, `--ease`, …) leaving the quickpay launcher, promo banners, and PIN prompt unstyled; all re-pointed at the semantic tokens.
- **Landing rebuild**: editorial fintech layout — frosted sticky nav, trust strip, hero with a live wallet-ledger preview, service cards with real provider logos, pricing cards, promo engine, CTA, footer.
- **App shell**: refined header/balance panel, bottom nav (now 5 items incl. Wallet), and a **functional desktop sidebar** — the sidebar CSS existed but no items were ever rendered, so desktop users had no navigation; now Home/Wallet/Services/History/Account.
- **Surfaces elevated**: auth card, service slide-in panels, network/provider chips, amount presets, plan lists, history filters, transaction rows, receipt overlay, modals, account screens, and the admin console (switched from legacy green to the Deep Teal master brand) all use the new tokens with premium radii and consistent type scale (Plus Jakarta Sans display + Inter body).
- **Font load deduplicated** (Inter was loaded twice).

### B. Functionality
- **New Wallet screen**: balance hero with Fund/Transactions actions, credits vs spend stats, and a wallet activity feed (wired into tab navigation).
- **Electricity phone-defect fix**: the JWT payload only carries `{ id, email }`, so cable/electricity/recharge-pin purchases sent an empty phone → VTPass `011 "phone is empty"` (reproduced live: failed order `2026081818237a6d7b11f771`, no debit). Routes now resolve the account holder's phone from the DB (`users.phone` is NOT NULL) and normalize to the `0XXXXXXXXXX` form VTPass accepts; applied to the interactive routes and the scheduled-purchase sweeper.
- **Payload audit**: `normalizeNigerianPhone` (`+234`/`234` → `0XXXXXXXXXX`, strips separators, fails closed) plus a test suite asserting no required provider field is empty/null/undefined/NaN and that unmapped products fail closed.
- **Desktop navigation** works for the first time (see A).

### C. Data / Catalogue
- **T2 (formerly 9mobile)**: official T2 logo added (`t2.png`, favicon-derived, verified 2026-08-18), `#FF5C05` accent, display name and all marketing/customer strings updated. Internal `9MOBILE`/`9mobile` keys preserved for VTPass (`etisalat`, `etisalat-data`) and contract tests.
- **All 12 DISCOs** now offered and selectable with official logos (JED, KAEDCO, EEDC, BEDC, APLE, YEDC added to IKEDC/EKEDC/AEDC/PHEDC/KEDC/IBEDC). Every service ID re-verified live against the active provider: all 12 return Prepaid/Postpaid variations.
- **Enabled-but-unmapped = 0**: the canonical registry (`getProductRegistry`) is derived from the same provider maps used to build purchases; tests assert no enabled product lacks a service ID/variation. Disabled items (Recharge Cards, JAMB/NECO/NABTEB) are visibly disabled with reasons.
- `SOURCES.md` updated with the provenance of every new logo.

- **Electricity live retry vend** after the phone fix: optional; needs operator confirmation (meter `45067460456`, IKEDC prepaid, ~₦1000).
- **Probe electricity token** from the earlier failed order is unrecoverable (request_id unknown) — accounting disclosure only; wallet was not debited.
- **Cloudflare SSL/TLS mode** not settleable via API — left alone (site healthy over HTTPS).
- Direct fetching of some DISCO sites was unavailable from the sandbox; logos were retrieved from official domains via the fetch path (see `SOURCES.md`).
- Recharge-card PIN vending and JAMB are deliberately disabled pending provider verification; enabling them is config-only via `VTPASS_PRODUCT_MAP` once confirmed.
